body.name: conservative split convex-projection test
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat d_{\rm sp}=\min_\theta\|\widehat b^{\rm te}-\widehat A^{\rm tr}\theta\|_2\) subject to \(\sum_{j=1}^Kj^{2\beta}\theta_j^2\le R^2\) and \(\eta\le\sum_{j=1}^K\theta_jv_j(w)\le1-\eta\) for every \(w\). Set \(t_q=32\eta^{-3/2}[\sqrt{K/(q n_{\rm te})}+R\sqrt{KS_\beta(K)/(q n_{\rm tr})}+\sqrt{K\log(2K/q)/n_{\rm tr}}]\), define \(t_\alpha=t_q\vert_{q=\alpha}\), and reject with \(\phi_{\rm sp}=\mathbf 1\{\widehat d_{\rm sp}>t_\alpha\}\).
